primary.title: Swiggy, Zomato, other gig workers to get new social security board: Pension, insurance benefits incoming? Know here
primary.summary: The National Social Security Board will design, monitor, and recommend targeted welfare schemes for the informal workforce in India. It is for unorganised, gig and platform workers.
